chain_words.nuance: looks only at the surface without examining the details
done quickly, with little attention to detail
sufficient for the purpose, though not especially careful
covers all the relevant details with care
leaves nothing important out, covering every possible aspect

explanation: These words all describe the depth of an examination, but with increasing completeness, from a surface glance to a review that leaves nothing out.

usage_notes.difference: 'Thorough' describes careful and complete work, while 'exhaustive' emphasises that nothing at all has been left out.
